script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for November 3. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Feel anxious?  Your heart races, muscles tense, breathing quickens.  Feel depressed?

Brain affects body: anxiety creates tension. Body affects brain: tension creates anxiety. The influence runs both ways. You can intervene from either direction. Can't change your thoughts?  Change your body.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: You can't separate mind and body.  Change one and you change the other.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Mind-Body Mapping - What Connections Do You Notice?.

Here's your activity: When you feel stressed, what happens in your body? When you're tired physically, what happens to your mood? Map your mind-body connections. Which door is easier to access when you need change? This helps you identify and leverage mind-body connections.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about brain and body working together can be applied to mind-body mapping - what connections do you notice?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
